scope: Naturlig og faglig nyttig sambruk i en kursdrøfting. Symmetrisk, positiv relevans mellom alle forskjellige temaer.

bands.label: Svært nær forbindelse eller særlig viktig kontrast
Tydelig forbindelse når drøftingens vinkling passer
Moderat eller indirekte forbindelse som bør forklares
Svakere forbindelse som ofte trenger flere mellomledd

profile_scoring.features: Manually authored, topic-specific concepts, mechanisms and application contexts; strength 1–3.
profile_scoring.calibration: Editorial calibration to the verbal relevance bands, not fitted against a measured ground truth.

path_scoring.allowed_step_source: Only individually reviewed pairs with weight >= 0.80.
path_scoring.forbidden_intermediates: Overview nodes, needs_source_expansion nodes, and the generic topics organisasjon, ledelse, organisasjonskultur, beslutningsprosesser, organisatorisk-laering, formelle-uformelle-trekk, koordinering.
path_scoring.interpretation: A possible writing route; never treated as proof of direct equivalence or causation.
path_scoring.selection: For a non-reviewed pair use max(profile estimate, strongest eligible short route).
path_scoring.tie_break: Lexicographically first normalized path for equal rounded route weights.

pair_reviews.selection: Tidligere direkte vurderinger beholdt etter semantisk gjennomgang; supplerende teori gir nye direkte par og presiseringer. Alle øvrige par beregnes på nytt fra reviderte profiler og korte skriveveier.
pair_reviews.precedence: Explicit pair review replaces profile/path estimates and may raise or lower the score.
pair_reviews.judgment: Holistic assessment across the five editorial dimensions. No invented per-dimension manual numeric ratings.

confidence.high: Individually reviewed pair with substantive endpoint source material; not independent scholarly verification.
confidence.medium: An inferred/profile pair, or a reviewed pair with limited source coverage.
confidence.low: At least one endpoint needs source expansion.

limitations: Many unreviewed scores are systematic estimates rather than independent pair-by-pair essay judgments.
Two strong relationships do not make the endpoints directly related; mediated routes are explicitly marked and capped.
A lower-scored pair may become more relevant for a particular assignment.
Differences of one or two hundredths should not be treated as objective precision.
The source document has not been independently fact-checked against the complete book.
2026-09: Vurdert mot leverte forelesninger og bokutdrag, ikke fullstendig ekstern fagkontroll. Eksemplenes felles kontekst inngår ikke i skåringen.
2026-10: Nye par fra Kaufmann kapittel 9 er faglige og redaksjonelle vurderinger; ureviewerte par er fortsatt estimater.
update_rule: Changing topic profiles, adding topics or changing pair reviews can change specificity weights and writing paths for other pairs. Regenerate all derived estimates and diagnostics; review direct judgments whose source content changed. Version and compare releases rather than silently reusing stale scores.
